description: Asks how decomposed and precomposed e-acute, sharp s and ss, the dotted and dotless I forms, and full- and half-width kana (Pat group p18) relate under '=', LIKE, StrComp text mode, UCase, LCase and Len, in one projection. A second query asks their ORDER BY S sequence under the General sort order. Fixture r-expr-1-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and loaded modules are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-expr-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
